hero.title: Show Villas in Two Cities, Toured From Either One
hero.body: Buyers in Riyadh and Jeddah tour Mohammed Al Habib Real Estate's built show villas in 3D, so off-plan villa sales no longer depend on traveling between the two cities.

sidebar: Eyal Al Fursan & Eyal Sadayem · master-planned villa communities within NHC suburbs
Show villa 3D tours · Sales gallery hardware · Sales team training

challenge.title: Selling Villas Off-Plan Across Two Cities
challenge.body: Mohammed Al Habib was building villa communities in Riyadh and Jeddah at the same time. Off-plan buyers wanted to see proportions, privacy and finish quality, but unfinished sites and the distance between galleries slowed their decisions.
rows: Families hesitate to visit active construction sites to see unfinished plots.
Show villa walkthrough: a true-scale 3D tour of the built show villa, available in city sales centers.
Buyers misread room volumes, ceiling heights and courtyard privacy on brochures.
Dimensionally exact navigation: buyers explore the majlis, family living areas and courtyard light room by room.
Riyadh buyers looking at Jeddah villas (and vice versa) can't easily visit in person.
Cross-gallery web sync: Riyadh advisors present live walkthroughs of Jeddah villas without travel.

solution.title: 3D Show Villa Tours for Both Cities
solution.body: Manzili captured the built show villas at Eyal Al Fursan and Eyal Sadayem and built interactive 3D tours used across Mohammed Al Habib's sales galleries, touch tables and mobile channels.

blocks.title: Full Interior & Exterior Capture
points: Detailed capture of the majlis, dining halls, family areas and garden courtyards.
Accurate daylight across ground, first and roof levels.

blocks.title: Cross-Gallery Integration
points: Riyadh touch screens show Eyal Sadayem, and Jeddah centers show Eyal Al Fursan.
Advisors in each city present the other city's inventory directly.

blocks.title: Commercial Touch Screens
points: Responsive touch screens in sales galleries in Riyadh and Jeddah.
Family groups review together with smooth zoom and floor switching.

blocks.title: Instant Mobile Follow-Up
points: Private web links sent to buyers by SMS or messaging apps after each visit.
Buyers revisit their preferred villa at home with the whole family.

enablement.title: Five-Minute Walkthroughs for Saudi Families
enablement.body: Saudi families judge villas on privacy, hosting space and everyday comfort. Manzili trained Mohammed Al Habib's sales teams to run structured 5-minute walkthroughs covering privacy, kitchen flow and master suites.

steps.title: Community & Plot Selection
steps.body: The advisor shows the community plan, villa position, street width and nearby mosques and parks.

steps.title: Show Villa Tour & Privacy Check
steps.body: The family walks through the 3D villa and sees how the guest majlis is separated from the private family areas.

steps.title: Finishes & Follow-Up Link
steps.body: Materials, bathroom fixtures and roof terraces come next. Before the family leaves, a private web link goes to the buyer's phone.
